title: Trailing Slash HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect on Catalog API
reproductionSteps: Inspect DevTools Network panel on initial page load
browserEvidence: Network request #37 returned HTTP 308 with response header 'location: /api/v1/products?include_archived=false', causing a redundant second HTTP GET roundtrip.
expectedBehavior: Catalog API requests should return HTTP 200 directly without redirect hops.
actualBehavior: FastAPI returned HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect due to trailing slash route normalization.
proposedFix: Strip the trailing slash from the catalog request URL in catalogApi.ts.

title: Broken 'Back to Store' Routing Traps Customer on Account Page
reproductionSteps: Sign in with test customer credentials and navigate to /account
Click the 'Back to Store' button at the top of CustomerAccountPage
Observe browser address bar updating to /store while the viewport remains stuck on CustomerAccountPage
browserEvidence: Clicking button updated window.location.pathname to /store via window.history.pushState, but Next.js App Router did not execute a route transition; body content remained on Account & Order History desk.
expectedBehavior: Clicking 'Back to Store' should navigate the user to the product catalog (/store or /).
actualBehavior: The user was trapped on the account desk because pushState bypassed Next.js router reconciliation.
confirmedRootCause: CustomerAccountPage.tsx lines 337, 467, 1242, and 1290 invoked window.history.pushState instead of the Next.js router / useNavigate hook.
proposedFix: Import useNavigate from @/lib/navigation and call navigate('/store') on all store transition buttons.

title: Form Input Elements Missing id and name Attributes in Catalog & BOM Calculator
flow: Product listing, quantity updates & BOM Estimator
browserEvidence: Chrome DevTools Console Issue: 'A form field element should have an id or name attribute (count: 8)' pointing to quantity inputs in BuyerCatalog and inputs in SolarBOMCalculator.
expectedBehavior: All form controls should possess valid id and name attributes for screen reader identification and browser autocomplete.
actualBehavior: Quantity number inputs lacked id and name attributes.
confirmedRootCause: src/components/storefront/BuyerCatalog.tsx line 552 rendered <input type='number'> without id or name props; SolarBOMCalculator.tsx inputs lacked name attributes.
proposedFix: Add unique id={`qty-input-${product.id}`} and name={`quantity_${product.id}`} in BuyerCatalog.tsx, and add descriptive name attributes to SolarBOMCalculator.tsx inputs.

title: Missing id, name, and Label htmlFor Associations in Delivery Address Form
reproductionSteps: Add any item to cart and open Checkout modal
Inspect DOM for form inputs in AddressModal
browserEvidence: Inputs for Full Name, Phone, Flat/Building, Street/Area, Pincode, and Post Office facility lacked id and name attributes, preventing programmatic label-input association.
expectedBehavior: Every input should have an explicit id matching its label's htmlFor attribute, along with a valid name attribute.
actualBehavior: Inputs were rendered with placeholder text only, without id or name attributes.
confirmedRootCause: src/components/auth/AddressModal.tsx lines 298-410 omitted id and name attributes on text inputs and select element.
proposedFix: Add id and name attributes to all inputs and select controls in AddressModal.tsx and bind labels using htmlFor.

title: WCAG 2.5.3 (Label in Name) Accessible Name Mismatch in Header Navigation
reproductionSteps: Run Lighthouse Snapshot audit on http://localhost:3000/
browserEvidence: Lighthouse Accessibility Audit failed 'label-content-name-mismatch' with score 0 for #header-category-dropdown, account button, and sub-navigation buttons.
expectedBehavior: Accessible name (aria-label) must contain the exact visible text displayed to the user.
actualBehavior: Visible text was 'Category: ALL', but aria-label was 'Filter products by category'; visible text was 'About Company', but aria-label was 'Navigate to About Apollo Engineering'.
confirmedRootCause: aria-label attributes in src/components/storefront/Header.tsx did not include the visible text string, violating WCAG 2.5.3.
proposedFix: Prefix aria-labels with visible text (e.g. `Category: ${selectedCategory} - Filter products by category`, `About Company - Apollo Engineering`).

title: Header Brand Logo Missing Explicit Width and Height Dimensions
browserEvidence: DevTools flagged 'Lazy-loaded images should have explicit dimensions' for /logo.webp.
expectedBehavior: Image elements should specify explicit width and height attributes to prevent layout shift (CLS).
actualBehavior: Logo image relied exclusively on CSS classes without HTML width and height attributes.
confirmedRootCause: src/components/storefront/Header.tsx line 68 rendered without width and height props.
proposedFix: Add width={180} and height={48} attributes to the logo img element in Header.tsx.
